title: Rewind
status: reference-only storyboard; use variants/index.json for incomplete rescues
notes: The original all-three group shots are reference artwork, not a playable Rewind outcome. Rewind only uses rescue masks 0–6; mask 7 selects Menjava.

frames.caption: The screen gives way. Small hands reach through the glass.
Maja, 1989. Luka, 1994. Tina, 2003. None of them a day older.
Outside, it is not their Halloween anymore.
Her mother still recognizes the costume.
The VCR clicks. Something is rewinding.
